title: Repair of B-52 Stratofortress Multifunction Color Displays (MFCD)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8117  AFSC PZABA
description_text: The Air Force intends to award a Sole Source contract to Raytheon Company, Cage Code of 96JA0. Contract will be for the repair of B-52 Stratofortress Multifunction Color Displays (MFCD). The current acquisition strategy is to issue a non-commercial, Firm Fixed Price contract with a basic year and four 1-year options. Anticiapated award will be a Requirements IDV contract. The contemplated period of performance is Mar 22 2027 thru Mar 21 2032.
